performanceOrder.label: 第1段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side. Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain. Leave to thy God to order and provide; In every change, He faithful will remain.

performanceOrder.label: 第1段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: thy best, thy heavenly Friend, Through thorny ways leads to a joyful end.

performanceOrder.label: 第2段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: thy God doth undertake. To guide the future, as He has the past. Thy hope, thy confidence let nothing shake; All now mysterious shall be bright at last.

performanceOrder.label: 第2段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: the waves and winds still know His voice Who ruled them while He dwelt below.

performanceOrder.label: 第4段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: the hour is hastening on. When we shall be forever with the Lord. When disappointment, grief and fear are gone, Sorrow forgot, love’s purest joys restored.

performanceOrder.label: 第4段
performanceOrder.text: Be still, my soul: when change and tears are past All safe and blessed we shall meet at last.
